profile_text.body:
Coursera is a public online education platform based in Mountain View, California, founded in 2012 and trading under the ticker COUR. The company describes itself as offering online courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees designed to teach job-ready skills. Its course catalog includes offerings from Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, Stanford, and other universities and companies.

The platform emphasizes AI and data science education alongside cybersecurity, software engineering, and business skills. According to its site, learners commonly transition into roles in project management, UX design, and data science through programs such as the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, and the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate. The company offers the Machine Learning Specialization, Deep Learning Specialization, AI Essentials Specialization, and AI Engineer Professional Certificate, among other AI-focused courses. Coursera Plus, described as an annual subscription, provides unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

Coursera faces 220 known legal exposures in California, though no specific cases are detailed in available records.
